findings.title: RollModeToggle is a complete production-orphan component

evidence.note: The file contains a standalone exported three-button component and no other production behavior.

evidence.measurement: Zero production imports or references outside the definition, measured by fixed-symbol and path git grep across 389 pinned production client TypeScript/TSX files, excluding tests, specs, test helpers, and src/test.
evidence.note: No shipped client path can render the component.

findings.problem: A 60-line UI component remains in the production tree despite having no production consumer. Its focused implementation, test presence, and module listing make it appear to be an active combat surface and create maintenance work disconnected from shipped behavior.
findings.proposedDirection: Remove the orphan production component. Banked L07-106 owns the misleading MODULE entry, while lane 06 owns the test-only surface.

findings.title: Character key hook constructs three filter objects no production caller reads

evidence.note: QueryFilter exists solely to type characterFilter, spellsFilter, and inventoryFilter on every CharacterKeys result.
Every useCharacterKeys invocation constructs all three query-filter wrappers alongside the consumed exact keys.

evidence.measurement: Each filter member has exactly two matches across 389 pinned production client TypeScript/TSX files—its declaration and initializer—and therefore zero production reads. Nine production modules call useCharacterKeys; their usage lines consume only characterKey, spellsKey, or inventoryKey.
evidence.note: The abandoned broad-invalidation API is constructed repeatedly but never observed.

findings.problem: The shared hook presents an abandoned invalidation API and allocates three filter wrappers for every caller even though production code cannot observe them. This enlarges a central cache-key contract and makes contributors reason about two invalidation representations when only exact keys are consumed here.
findings.proposedDirection: Delete the three filter members and the now-unused QueryFilter interface, leaving useCharacterKeys focused on its three consumed exact keys. Banked L07-108 owns the associated comment correction.

priorPackOverlap.novelty: The completed client query-layer cluster left these three members in place; the pinned production reference graph now establishes that all three are unread.
